'''Anturus''' was a pastoral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Anturus system/Legends|eponymous star system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Anturus lay along the important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] that linked it to the [[Karfeddion system/Legends|Karfeddion]], [[Voorsbain system/Legends|Voorsbain]] and [[Denebia system/Legends|Denebia systems]].<ref name="EA" />

Anturus was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[House Picutorion]], which was still known as the Outsider House despite having been part of [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex society]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. The Outsider House traced its origins to the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] warlord-turned-merchant-prince [[Osted Picutorion]] and the [[Crimson Days]]. Within a generation of the Crimson Days, House Anturi had become House Picutorion, although the other Houses continued to use the old name in private.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Anturus was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
